sections.heading: Part A — UAT Plan
paragraphs: This document defines the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plan for (S)TeemBang and records execution results. UAT validates that the system meets business and user needs from the perspective of representative end users and the product owner.

sections.heading: A.1 UAT Objectives
bullets: Confirm core fitness workflows are intuitive for non-technical users
Validate daily goal tracking (steps, calories, workouts) matches user expectations
Verify admin can monitor member activity and platform statistics
Obtain formal sign-off before project delivery

sections.heading: A.3 UAT Scope
bullets: In scope: Registration, login, profile setup, avatar upload, dashboard rings, workout timer, step simulation, goal creation/tracking, analytics, notifications, admin console
Out of scope: Capacitor native build, production deployment, third-party wearable integration

sections.heading: A.5 UAT Entry Criteria
bullets: System testing completed with 100% pass rate
All Critical/High defects closed or deferred with approval

sections.heading: A.7 Acceptance Criteria (Business)
paragraphs: The following business acceptance criteria must be satisfied for UAT sign-off. Each criterion maps to one or more UAT scenarios executed during May 13–14, 2026.

rows: A new user can register, set profile details, and define daily targets for steps, calories, and workouts
A member can log a timed workout and see updated calories and workout count on the dashboard
A member can track steps via simulation on desktop and sync to the server
Goals show accurate progress bars after logging activities
Analytics page displays trend data for at least 7 days
Profile photo upload displays correctly on profile and home dashboard
Admin can view aggregate platform activity for the current day
Admin can inspect individual member daily progress against targets
Notifications can be read and unread count updates

sections.heading: Part B — UAT Scenarios & Results
paragraphs: Each scenario was executed by a group member acting as an end user on May 13–14, 2026.

rows: New user registers and completes profile with daily targets
Member logs workout using timer and sees dashboard update
Workout count and calories reflected immediately
Member simulates walk and syncs steps to daily goal
Simulation works on desktop without phone sensors
Member creates weekly steps goal and tracks progress
Member uploads profile photo and sees it on dashboard
Admin views platform activity and member list
Platform rings and user cards load
Admin expands member detail with daily progress
Member receives and marks notification as read

sections.heading: B.2 Detailed Scenario Steps
paragraphs: UAT-01 — Registration and profile setup: (1) Navigate to /register. (2) Enter full name, unique email, password ≥8 chars. (3) Submit and confirm redirect to Profile. (4) Enter height 170 cm, weight 68 kg, age 22, fitness level Beginner. (5) Set daily targets: 10,000 steps, 500 kcal, 1 workout. (6) Save and verify view mode displays all values.

UAT-02 — Workout timer: (1) Login as demo@steambang.com. (2) Open Train page, select Timer mode. (3) Choose category Running, start timer for 60 seconds. (4) Stop and save workout. (5) Return to Dashboard and confirm workouts ring and calorie total increased.
UAT-03 — Step simulation: (1) On Dashboard click Simulate walk. (2) Wait 10 seconds. (3) Stop simulation and click Sync steps. (4) Confirm success toast and updated step count on dashboard ring.
UAT-04 — Weekly goal: (1) Open Goals, create new goal — metric Steps, period Weekly, target 50,000. (2) Sync steps from dashboard. (3) Open Goals and confirm progress percentage updated.
UAT-05 — Analytics: (1) Open Stats page. (2) Select 14-day range. (3) Toggle between Steps, Calories, and Workouts metrics. (4) Confirm chart renders without errors.
UAT-06 — Avatar upload: (1) Profile → Edit mode. (2) Click camera icon, select JPEG under 2 MB. (3) Save profile. (4) Verify avatar on Profile and Dashboard header.
UAT-07 — Admin overview: (1) Login as admin@steambang.com. (2) Confirm redirect to Admin console. (3) Review platform activity rings and member list.
UAT-08 — Admin member detail: (1) Expand demo member card. (2) Verify daily targets, today's progress bars, active goals, and recent activity feed.
UAT-09 — Notifications: (1) Login as member with unread notifications. (2) Open notification panel. (3) Tap unread item. (4) Confirm badge count decreases.

sections.heading: B.3 User Feedback Summary
bullets: Positive: Dark premium UI, clear daily goal rings on home page, intuitive bottom navigation
Positive: Metric-specific goal tracking (simulate steps, timer for workouts, manual calories)
Suggestion: Add push notifications on mobile (future Capacitor release)
Suggestion: Export analytics to PDF (deferred to future sprint)

rows: Analytics chart legend text slightly small on mobile
No confirmation dialog before deleting goal

sections.heading: Part C — UAT Conclusion & Sign-Off
paragraphs: UAT Summary: 9 scenarios executed. Passed: 9. Failed: 0. Pass rate: 100%.
Two Low-severity items deferred with product owner acknowledgment. No Critical or High defects remain open.
The (S)TeemBang application is accepted for delivery as Group 4's SDLC capstone project.
